title: Green Eggs and Ham by Dr. Seuss
description:
Novels & Nibbles has gone Seussian this week.

Would you, could you, read this book?
Take a chance and have a look!

Green eggs, ham and rhymes galore,
A funny tale you’ll adore.

About trying something strange and new,
Then finding out it’s meant for you!

Our version of green eggs and ham involves a toasty ciabatta, warm and grand, stacked with apple-smoked ham.
An egg just how you like it best, with melty provolone above the rest.
Arugula fresh, red peppers roasted, and a house-made chimi worth being boasted!

Try it with our new strawberry and goat cheese seasonal salad.

One bite, Two bites, here’s the plan, you might just love this green eggs and ham!
